description: This is a test module that verifies the behavior of the 'remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment' utility function in the 'litellm.proxy.common_utils.openai_endpoint_utils' module. It contains multiple test cases using pytest to check that sensitive information like API keys, secrets, and credentials are properly masked or removed from model configuration dictionaries.

methods.name: test_remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment(model_config: dict, expected_config: dict)
methods.description: Tests that the 'remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment' function correctly sanitizes model configuration dictionaries by masking or removing sensitive fields.

methods.name: test_remove_sensitive_info_from_deployment_with_excluded_keys()
methods.description: Verifies that the function respects 'excluded_keys' to prevent masking of specific keys, and that it still removes certain sensitive keys regardless of exclusions.
